subject: Readiness alignment: scrub, ownership, and exception escrow
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlascloud.com>
Cc: procurement@atlascloud.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Readiness alignment: scrub, ownership, and exception escrow

Team / Sam —

Quick alignment ahead of next-week activation window. We ran a brief readiness scrub with Product and Docs yesterday; three key asks emerged that I want to land before Friday so AtlasCloud can keep the Sept 20 activation:

1) Ownership for the two enablement flows (admin onboarding + runtime tuning) — need clear owners and training slots.
2) Exception escrow proposal — we sketched a 72-hour delay escrow for non-blocking platform items (docs, minor infra tweaks) with a roll-back trigger if SLA-affecting items remain. Need legal/Security OK and an internal sign-off process.
3) Final enablement deck and a single source-of-truth for rollback/runbook.

I attached a working draft of the enablement deck and the template for the exception escrow. Please read the escrow template and call out any non-starters.

Asks: can each of you confirm (A) who will own the enablement lane, (B) three candidate training slots next week, and (C) any absolute no-go items for the escrow? Sam / Procurement — if there are procurement timelines we should bake into the escrow, flag them.

Attachments: enablement-deck-v2.pdf (slides), exception-escrow-template.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Launch PM, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlascloud.com>
Cc: procurement@atlascloud.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Readiness alignment: scrub, ownership, and exception escrow

Ava — thanks. Quick notes from enablement angle:

- I can own admin onboarding lane (Marissa). Proposed owner for runtime tuning: Ben (unless he prefers not to).
- Training slots (US-friendly): Wed 9/15 10:00-11:30 PT, Thu 9/16 14:00-15:30 PT, Mon 9/20 09:00-10:30 PT. Each slot has 45m presentation + 30m hands-on.
- Absolute no-go for escrow: any window that allows shipping an unscoped data retention change or bypasses encryption checks. Those must be triaged into a blocking path.

I've commented in the Drive doc (link below) on slide 6 where we need a short troubleshooting checklist and on slide 10 for the RBAC mapping example.

Marissa Cole
Developer Relations / Enablement
marissa@redwood.com

-----
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlascloud.com>
Cc: procurement@atlascloud.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 12:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Readiness alignment: scrub, ownership, and exception escrow

Looping in infra considerations — the escrow looks reasonable as a temporary operational buffer, but two asks:

1) We need an explicit rollback trigger tied to SLOs (error rate > X% for 10m or sustained latency > Y p50). Can Legal/Compliance sign off on that as a controlled rollback?
2) If Atlas needs extra time for their procurement, we should reserve a secondary activation week (9/27) to avoid forced rushes.

I can review the rollback triggers with SRE tomorrow. If we frame the escrow as a gated 72-hour soft window with automatic SLO checks, it should be safe.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Product Ops
vivek@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlascloud.com>
Cc: procurement@atlascloud.com
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 09:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Readiness alignment: scrub, ownership, and exception escrow

Confirming I can own runtime tuning lane. Couple of practicals:

- I need the final model variant and typical sequence-length profiles from Atlas by EOD 9/14 to build the tuning checklist. Sam — can you share the perf profile or a sample payload?
- For the enablement deck, add a one-page appendix with ‘troubleshooting quick wins’ + expected token-cost impact for common sequences. That helps customers decide whether to use quantized variants.

Attachment: small snippet of tuning checklist (inline in Drive comments).

Ben Carter
Inference Platform Eng
ben@redwood.com

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.com>, Sam Torres <sam.torres@atlascloud.com>
Cc: procurement@atlascloud.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Readiness alignment: scrub, ownership, and exception escrow

Thanks all — consolidating actions and owners below (will publish as the canonical readiness doc and create the Jira ticket this afternoon):

- Admin onboarding owner: Marissa Cole — deliver updated slides + troubleshooting checklist by 9/14. Training slots: pick one of the proposed times, Marissa to confirm by EOD 9/9.
- Runtime tuning owner: Ben Carter — Ben to ingest Atlas perf profile by 9/14 (Sam to share sample payload). Ben will produce tuning checklist and token-cost appendix.
- Escrow & rollback triggers: Vivek to draft SLO-based rollback language and work with Legal; propose final language by 9/10.
- Procurement constraints: Sam / procurement@atlascloud.com — if you need the 9/27 secondary activation window, call it out by EOD 9/9.

Drive + canonical doc: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C_example_readiness_doc
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/DEAL-8321
Jira (will be created): RD-INF-1543 (activation readiness checklist)

I’ll attach the final enablement deck once Marissa confirms slides. If anyone sees a blocker that should convert the escrow into a blocking requirement (especially Security or Legal items), please escalate to me immediately and we’ll pause the activation until remediated.

Ava Chen
Launch PM, Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: enablement-deck-v2.pdf, exception-escrow-template.xlsx
